item.title: Show HN: Open Vibe Coded Elite – Harmless
item.summary: I'm trying out a bit of an experiment - I've had Claude (and other models) building this for me: https://harmless.atomic14.com/ It's an "Open Vibe Code" project - I won't be accepting any PRs, instead, open an issue https://github.com/atomic14/harmless/issues and I'll point claude at all the issues periodically and see what it does. The current game is very playable right now and has quite a few features. Push '?' to get the keyboard layout. Classic Elite was very keyboard heavy - it you played it when you were younger it will feel very familiar. If you've never played it... you'll pick it up soon enough!
